info.title: Hermiq Register
info.description: Hermiq register v0.29.0 — speech-services: Agent gains four OPTIONAL voice* fields — voiceInputEngine and voiceOutputEngine (auto|browser|local|off), voiceSilenceTimeout (ms), voiceConversationEnabled. They decide whether a given agent's dictation goes to the browser's recogniser (in Chrome: Google's servers) or to this instance's whisper, and a 'local' agent NEVER falls back to the browser. ⚠️ voice* rather than talk*: talkEnabled already exists and means Nextcloud Talk rooms, not microphones. ⚠️ THE VERSION BUMP IS THE POINT: the import is gated on info.version, so a schema shipped without one is inert on every existing install with no error anywhere. Previous v0.28.0 — hermiq-agent-application-slug: Agent gains the OPTIONAL applicationSlug (the owning external Application's slug, e.g. hydra-console for the four Hydra-* agents), mirroring Flow.applicationSlug (hydra-flow-application-slug). Empty for an agent hermiq owns outright; never required. ⚠️ THE VERSION BUMP IS THE POINT: the import is gated on info.version, so a schema shipped without one is inert on every existing install with no error anywhere. Previous v0.27.0 — Hermiq register v0.25.0 — tool-discovery-and-access-requests: adds the ToolAccessRequest schema. An agent can now discover a capability it does not hold and ASK for it; the request notifies the agent owner and grants nothing on its own. ⚠️ THE VERSION BUMP IS THE POINT: the import is gated on info.version, so a schema shipped without one is inert on every existing install with no error anywhere. Previous v0.24.0 — Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud. v0.24.0 — agent-object-owner-authorization: Agent gains an authorization block granting read to authenticated users. create/update/delete are OMITTED ON PURPOSE — OpenRegister fails closed on an action a non-empty block does not list, so omission is what makes writes owner-only (owners and admins are admitted before that check). Do NOT 'complete' the block by adding write actions: that reopens a reproduced hole in which any authenticated user could rewrite any agent's tool grants, prompt, model and delegationAllowlist. `scope: private` was rejected — it covers every action and would close reads for invited users too. x-openregister.description: Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: A schedule that fires an OpenRegister agent on a cron expression, a fixed interval, or once at a future time.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the OpenRegister Agent this schedule runs (reference to the Agent entity owned by OpenRegister)

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Trigger type: run once, on a fixed interval, or on a cron expression

intervalMinutes.title: Interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between runs (required when kind=interval)

runAt.title: Run at
runAt.description: Timestamp of the single run (required when kind=once)

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Optional task text passed to the agent run

deliver.title: Deliver to
deliver.description: Where the run output is delivered. talk/notification/none stay inside this Nextcloud instance. email (delivery-channels) sends the redacted output via OCP\Mail\IMailer. webhook (delivery-channels) POSTs the redacted, size-capped output to deliverTarget, HMAC-signed. Reaching a named chat platform (Slack/Matrix/Telegram/WhatsApp/Teams) is OpenConnector's job, not a Hermiq delivery channel — point webhook at an OpenConnector Source or an n8n webhook trigger.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Disabled schedules are skipped by the dispatcher

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: Optional finite-repeat control; omit or null to run forever

times.title: Total runs
times.description: Total number of runs before the schedule is removed

nextRun.title: Next run
nextRun.description: Derived: next fire time — written by the dispatcher, not the user

lastStatus.title: Last status
lastStatus.description: Derived: outcome of the last run — written by the dispatcher

lastError.title: Last error
lastError.description: Derived: error message from the last run, if any — written by the dispatcher

deliverTarget.title: Deliver target
deliverTarget.description: Per-channel meaning (delivery-channels): deliver=talk — the Nextcloud Talk room token to post to (the owner must be a member); empty falls back to the owner's Note-to-self conversation. deliver=email — the recipient email address; empty falls back to the owner's own Nextcloud account email. deliver=webhook — the destination URL to POST to (required; empty is a hard misconfiguration recorded as lastDeliveryError, never attempted).

lastDeliveryError.title: Last delivery error
lastDeliveryError.description: Derived: the delivery error from the last run, if any — written by the delivery layer; cleared on a successful delivery

requiresApproval.title: Requires approval
requiresApproval.description: When true, a due run does not execute automatically — the dispatcher creates a pending Approval and notifies the reviewer; the run proceeds only after approval (EU AI Act Art. 14 human oversight).

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who must approve a gated run — a Nextcloud user id or group id (see reviewerType). If empty, the schedule owner is the reviewer.

reviewerType.title: Reviewer type
reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a Nextcloud user id or a group id.

retryEnabled.title: Retry enabled
retryEnabled.description: When true, a failed run is retried with exponential backoff (up to retryMaxAttempts) before being marked dead-letter (run-reliability).

retryMaxAttempts.title: Retry max attempts
retryMaxAttempts.description: Total attempts (including the first) for one occurrence before it is marked dead-letter.

retryBackoffBaseSeconds.title: Retry backoff base (seconds)
retryBackoffBaseSeconds.description: Base delay for exponential backoff between retry attempts: backoffBase * 2^(attempt-1).

circuitBreakerThreshold.title: Circuit breaker threshold
circuitBreakerThreshold.description: Consecutive dead-lettered occurrences before the schedule is auto-paused.

retryState.title: Retry state
retryState.description: Derived: in-progress retry-sequence bookkeeping — written by the dispatcher, not the user; null when no retry is pending.

attempt.title: Attempt
attempt.description: The last attempt number that failed.

nextAttemptAt.title: Next attempt at
nextAttemptAt.description: When the next retry attempt is due to fire.

consecutiveDeadLetters.title: Consecutive dead-letters
consecutiveDeadLetters.description: Derived: consecutive dead-lettered occurrences — written by the dispatcher; resets to 0 on any successful run.

deliverWebhookMaxAttempts.title: Webhook delivery max attempts
deliverWebhookMaxAttempts.description: delivery-channels: total attempts (including the first) for one webhook delivery before it is recorded as failed. Mirrors retryMaxAttempts' shape at a different, seconds-scale timescale — see retryBackoffBaseSeconds' description for why it is not the same field.

deliverWebhookBackoffBaseSeconds.title: Webhook delivery backoff base (seconds)
deliverWebhookBackoffBaseSeconds.description: delivery-channels: base delay for exponential backoff between webhook delivery attempts (backoffBase * 2^(attempt-1)), retried synchronously within the same dispatch tick — a deliberately smaller-scale sibling of retryBackoffBaseSeconds (which retries the whole agent turn, in minutes, on a later tick), not a reuse of it.

deliverWebhookSecretConfigured.title: Webhook secret configured
deliverWebhookSecretConfigured.description: Derived: whether a webhook signing secret has been minted for this schedule — a UI hint only, never the secret itself. The plaintext secret lives in OCP\Security\ICredentialsManager, never in this OpenRegister object.

deliverWebhookSecretRotatedAt.title: Webhook secret rotated at
deliverWebhookSecretRotatedAt.description: Derived: when the webhook signing secret was last minted or rotated; null when no secret has ever been minted.

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description: A human-oversight approval request for a gated agent run or tool invocation (EU AI Act Art. 14); its status is the audited pending→approved/denied decision. Gates a scheduled run (sourceType=schedule, the original shape), a flow-triggered run (sourceType=flow, from OpenRegister's AgentRunRequestedEvent), a webhook-triggered run (sourceType=webhook, from an external system calling the agent's inbound webhook), an un-granted destructive tool invocation attempted mid-run (sourceType=tool, agent-tool-governance-and-disclosure), or a guardrail-policy confirm-classified tool call (sourceType=toolcall, agent-guardrails — distinct from sourceType=tool: keyed by agentId+toolId+arguments and single-use/TTL-bounded rather than a permanent per-(agentId,toolId) decision).

status.title: Status
status.description: The approval state machine: pending -> approved/denied for every gating sourceType. `overridden` is ADVISORY-ONLY and terminal-at-creation — the human accepted the AI's suggestion in principle but supplied a different value (advisoryContext.actualValue). It is not reachable from `pending` and no gating flow may produce it.

sourceType.title: Source type
sourceType.description: What the gated action resumes into on approval: a Hermiq Schedule (default, back-compatible), a flow-triggered agent run, a webhook-triggered agent run, an un-granted destructive tool invocation (nothing auto-resumes — the next invocation attempt of the same agentId+toolId proceeds), a guardrail-policy confirm-classified tool call (nothing auto-resumes — the next MATCHING agentId+toolId+arguments attempt within the validity window proceeds exactly once, then the authorization expires), or a skill consolidation draft (skill-self-improvement: the pending→approved transition applies the draft onto the Skill as a new version from ANY surface; denial reconciles the draft to rejected)., or an ADVISORY AI decision recorded after the fact (ai-oversight — the only NON-BLOCKING variant: nothing was ever gated, the human already acted, and the record is Art. 14 evidence rather than a permission. Created terminal; an advisory Approval is never `pending`.)

scheduleId.title: Schedule
scheduleId.description: UUID of the Schedule whose run is gated. Present only when sourceType=schedule.

correlationId.title: Correlation ID
correlationId.description: Idempotency key for a flow-triggered, webhook-triggered, or guardrail toolcall approval. For sourceType=flow/webhook it is the dispatch's own correlationId; for sourceType=toolcall it is hash('sha256', agentId+toolId+ksorted-arguments) — scheduleId serves this role for sourceType=schedule.

flowContext.title: Flow context
flowContext.description: The flow-triggered run's resume context (subjectUuid/subjectRegister/subjectSchema/resultField/skill/mode/flowName/correlationId). Present only when sourceType=flow.

webhookContext.title: Webhook context
webhookContext.description: The webhook-triggered run's resume context (agentId/payload/correlationId/requiresApproval/reviewer/reviewerType). The payload is redacted before it is stored here (redaction-before-persist). Present only when sourceType=webhook.

toolId.title: Tool ID
toolId.description: Full namespaced MCP tool id ({app}.{schema}.{verb} or {app}.{toolName}) whose invocation is gated. Present only when sourceType=tool or sourceType=toolcall; the idempotency key together with agentId (sourceType=tool) or part of the correlationId hash (sourceType=toolcall).

toolArguments.title: Tool arguments
toolArguments.description: The gated tool call's arguments (redacted before persistence — redaction-before-persist). Present only when sourceType=toolcall.

consumedAt.title: Consumed at
consumedAt.description: Derived: when an approved sourceType=toolcall Approval authorised its one matching retry — set at that moment so it can never authorise a second invocation. Present only when sourceType=toolcall.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent the gated run/invocation would act as. OMITTED (not empty) for sourceType=skill-draft — a draft approval gates a skill version, not an agent run — which is why this property is not in `required`.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt the gated run would send to the agent.

requestedAt.title: Requested at
requestedAt.description: When the approval was requested (the dispatcher gated the run).

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Resolved reviewer copied from the Schedule — a user id or group id (see reviewerType).

reviewerType.title: Reviewer type
reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a user id or a group id.

decidedAt.title: Decided at
decidedAt.description: Derived: when the decision was made — written by the decision endpoint.

decidedBy.title: Decided by
decidedBy.description: Derived: the user id who approved or denied — written by the decision endpoint.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional decision reason (typically supplied on denial).

talkMessageId.title: Talk message
talkMessageId.description: Id of the Nextcloud Talk message carrying this approval request. Declared top-level (not nested) because the reaction handler resolves an approval BY this value, and OpenRegister's dot-path filters on nested JSON match nothing. Empty or unset means the request was never posted to Talk and cannot be decided from there.

talkRoomToken.title: Talk room token
talkRoomToken.description: The Nextcloud Talk room this approval request was posted into, so a decision taken by reaction can be confirmed in the same place. Written alongside talkMessageId by the notifier.

decidedVia.title: Decided via
decidedVia.description: How the decision arrived: 'inbox' (the Hermiq approvals inbox) or 'reaction' (a 👍/👎 on the Talk message). Derived — written by the decision path, never by a user — so an audit reader can distinguish a one-click approval from a considered one. Deliberately not an enum, so a future decision surface can record itself without a schema change.

draftId.title: Skill draft
draftId.description: UUID of the SkillDraft this Approval decides. Present only when sourceType=skill-draft.

skillId.title: Skill
skillId.description: UUID of the Skill the gated draft would become a new version of. Present only when sourceType=skill-draft.

draftPayload.title: Draft decision evidence
draftPayload.description: REQUIRED at creation for sourceType=skill-draft (an Approval missing any field is invalid and never reaches an inbox): everything an informed out-of-band decision needs without opening SkillDetail.

deepLink.title: Deep link
deepLink.description: Deep link to the SkillDetail review surface carrying the full side-by-side diff.

scanVerdict.title: Scan verdict
scanVerdict.description: The content-scan verdict recorded during pre-qualification (learnings.md scanned as instruction content).

evalDelta.title: Eval delta
evalDelta.description: The paired draft-vs-active eval delta (draftPassRate - activePassRate). Absent when noEvalEvidence is true.

noEvalEvidence.title: No eval evidence
noEvalEvidence.description: True when the skill has no linked EvalDataset — the draft survived pre-qualification honestly unmeasured and can never grant L5.

learningsSummary.title: Learnings summary
learningsSummary.description: One-line summary of the driving learnings entries behind the proposal.

advisoryContext.title: Advisory context
advisoryContext.description: REQUIRED at creation for sourceType=advisory. Carries what the AI proposed and what the human did with it, for an action that was never gated. `originApp` is the app whose surface produced the suggestion (the record lives here, in hermiq, but the decision happened there); `subjectType` + `subjectId` point at that app's own object (a case, a document) without hermiq needing to resolve it. An advisory Approval missing this object is evidence of nothing and must be rejected at write time.

originApp.title: Origin app
originApp.description: App id whose surface produced the suggestion, e.g. `procest`.

suggestionType.title: Suggestion type
suggestionType.description: What kind of suggestion this was — classification, extraction, summarisation, routing, answer.

action.title: Action
action.description: The concrete operation the suggestion was for, in the origin app's own vocabulary.

subjectType.title: Subject type
subjectType.description: The origin app's object type the suggestion applied to, e.g. `case` or `document`.

subjectId.title: Subject
subjectId.description: Identifier of that object in the origin app. Deliberately NOT a $ref: hermiq does not resolve another app's register.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that produced the suggestion.

suggestion.title: Suggestion
suggestion.description: What the AI proposed, as presented to the human.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: The model's confidence, 0..1, when it reported one.

actualValue.title: Actual value
actualValue.description: What the human actually used. Meaningful when status=overridden; that difference IS the oversight evidence.

responseTimeMs.title: Response time (ms)
responseTimeMs.description: How long the model took, kept because a suggestion nobody waited for is a different oversight risk than one that blocked a handler.

AgentWebhook.title: Agent webhook
AgentWebhook.description: A per-agent, secret-authenticated inbound webhook (agent-webhook-trigger) that lets an external system (n8n, a CI pipeline, a third-party SaaS event) trigger a governed agent run without a Nextcloud session. Stores only a SHA-256 hash of the shared secret — never the plaintext at rest — plus the optional human-approval gate fields (mirroring Schedule's requiresApproval/reviewer/reviewerType). One AgentWebhook per agent.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent this webhook triggers. One AgentWebhook per agent.

secretHash.title: Secret hash
secretHash.description: Derived: hash('sha256', secret) — the plaintext secret is never persisted. Verified via hash_equals() at trigger time.

secretPrefix.title: Secret prefix
secretPrefix.description: Derived: the first 8 characters of the plaintext secret (e.g. "hwh_ab12"), for admin identification only — not sensitive on its own.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: false after revoke; the trigger endpoint rejects every request for a disabled webhook.

requiresApproval.title: Requires approval
requiresApproval.description: When true, a valid trigger does not run the agent automatically — a pending Approval (sourceType=webhook) is created and the reviewer notified; the run proceeds only after approval (EU AI Act Art. 14 human oversight).

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who must approve a gated run — a Nextcloud user id or group id (see reviewerType). If empty, the agent owner is the reviewer.

reviewerType.title: Reviewer type
reviewerType.description: Whether reviewer is a Nextcloud user id or a group id.

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: When the webhook secret was first created.

rotatedAt.title: Rotated at
rotatedAt.description: Derived: when the secret was last rotated — null until the first rotation.

lastUsedAt.title: Last used at
lastUsedAt.description: Derived: when the trigger endpoint last accepted a valid, enabled request for this webhook — best-effort, non-fatal.

AiFeature.title: AI feature
AiFeature.description: A design-time inventory entry for a high-risk AI feature this platform provides (EU AI Act registration/oversight). Risk-classified and gated by a declarative lifecycle whose enable transition requires a DPO acknowledgement.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: The machine identifier of the AI feature (also the IAppConfig dpo_ack key suffix).

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the AI feature.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the AI feature does and why it is risk-relevant.

riskCategory.title: Risk category
riskCategory.description: EU AI Act risk classification of the feature.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Activation state, managed by the OpenRegister lifecycle engine (never set directly).

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: The hermiq multi-tenancy scope used to key the DPO acknowledgement.

dpoAckBy.title: DPO acknowledged by
dpoAckBy.description: Derived: the user id of the DPO who acknowledged the feature — written by the acknowledge endpoint.

dpoAckAt.title: DPO acknowledged at
dpoAckAt.description: Derived: when the DPO acknowledgement was recorded — written by the acknowledge endpoint.

doel.title: Purpose
doel.description: Algoritmekader: the purpose of the algorithm — why the public body deploys it. Mandatory only to publish to the Algoritmeregister.

statutoryBasis.title: Legal basis
statutoryBasis.description: Algoritmekader: the legal basis for using the algorithm. Mandatory only to publish.

impactAssessments.title: Impact assessments
impactAssessments.description: Algoritmekader: the impact assessments performed (IAMA / DPIA / FRAIA) with a reference to each. Mandatory only to publish.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: A reference (document id / URL) to the completed assessment.

dataBronnen.title: Data sources
dataBronnen.description: Algoritmekader: the data sources and data categories the algorithm uses. Mandatory only to publish.

humanIntervention.title: Human oversight
humanIntervention.description: Algoritmekader: the human-oversight arrangement (links to the human-approval gate). Mandatory only to publish.

responsible.title: Responsible party
responsible.description: Algoritmekader: the responsible organisation and its contact. Mandatory only to publish.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: A contact point (email / department) for the algorithm.

publicatiecategorie.title: Publication category
publicatiecategorie.description: Algoritmekader: the publication category of the algorithm in the national register. Mandatory only to publish.

algoritmeregisterStatus.title: Algoritmeregister status
algoritmeregisterStatus.description: Publication state in the national Algoritmeregister. Managed by the publish / withdraw actions (never set directly).

algoritmeregisterRef.title: Algoritmeregister reference
algoritmeregisterRef.description: Derived: the external register id / URL of the published entry, empty until published.

TenantControl.title: Tenant control
TenantControl.description: Per-organisation kill-switch plus the stated EU AI Act Art. 12 retention-period policy (agent-lifecycle-governance). When engaged, the dispatcher halts all agent runs for the organisation (tenant scope comes from ObjectEntity.organisation).

engaged.title: Engaged
engaged.description: When true, all agent runs for this organisation are halted.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason for engaging the kill-switch.

engagedBy.title: Engaged by
engagedBy.description: The user id who engaged/disengaged the kill-switch.

retentionMonths.title: Retention period (months)
retentionMonths.description: Stated EU AI Act Art. 12 record-keeping retention period for this organisation's governance records; a value below 6 is rejected at the service layer. This is a stated policy only — it does not trigger automated purge/archive (agent-lifecycle-governance).

ModelPolicy.title: Model policy
ModelPolicy.description: Per-organisation allowlist of chat provider/model pairs an organisation's agents may use, plus an optional default model. A policy with no organisation (tenant scope empty) is the instance-wide default applied when an organisation has none of its own (tenant-model-policy). Enforced at ProviderFactory::createChatDriver() — every agent-turn trigger path (schedule, Run now, conversation, flow listener) is checked against the caller's effective policy.

allowed.title: Allowed providers
allowed.description: Allowlisted {provider, models[]} pairs drawn from the four supported chat drivers. An empty models[] for an allowed provider means any model id for that provider is permitted.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: One of the four supported chat drivers.

models.title: Models
models.description: Allowed model ids for this provider; empty means any model id is permitted.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Optional suggested default {provider, model} surfaced to the agent create/edit form; MUST itself be one of the allowed provider/model combinations (service-level validation).

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which LLM provider the suggested default comes from. Must be one of the providers this policy allows.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model identifier as the provider names it (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, llama3.1). Must be allowed for the chosen provider.

GuardrailPolicy.title: Guardrail policy
GuardrailPolicy.description: Per-organisation content and tool-risk guardrail (agent-guardrails): input filters (PII/secret + prompt-injection detection before the LLM turn), output filters (PII/secret detection before persistence and before delivery), and a per-tool auto/confirm/deny risk classification enforced before ToolRegistryFacade::invokeTool() is ever reached. A policy with no organisation (tenant scope empty) is the instance-wide default applied when an organisation has none of its own, mirroring ModelPolicy's own-policy → instance-default resolution. No policy anywhere (or `enabled: false`) means every filter is off and every tool is `auto` — identical to the app's behavior before this change (fail-open, opt-in — like Budget/Schedule.requiresApproval, NOT like ModelPolicy's fail-closed fallback).

inputFilters.title: Input filters
inputFilters.description: Checks applied to the user/prompt text BEFORE it is sent to the LLM.

piiAction.title: PII/secret action
piiAction.description: off = no check; redact = mask detected PII/secrets and send/persist the masked text; block = refuse the turn before the LLM is ever called.

promptInjectionAction.title: Prompt-injection action
promptInjectionAction.description: off = no check; block = refuse the turn before the LLM is ever called when a known instruction-override pattern is detected. There is no redact action for prompt injection — an override attempt can only be refused, never partially masked.

outputFilters.title: Output filters
outputFilters.description: Checks applied to the LLM's response text before it is persisted or delivered.

piiAction.title: PII/secret action
piiAction.description: off = no check; redact = mask detected PII/secrets in the persisted/delivered text; block = withhold the raw output (replaced with a placeholder) from both persistence and delivery.

toolPolicy.title: Tool risk classification
toolPolicy.description: Per-tool auto/confirm/deny classification. A tool absent from this list defaults to auto (zero behavior change). auto = invoked unchanged; confirm = refused until a matching human approval exists (sourceType=toolcall Approval); deny = never invoked, refused unconditionally.

toolId.title: Tool ID
toolId.description: Full namespaced MCP tool id ({app}.{schema}.{verb} or {app}.{toolName}).

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: How this tool is treated at call time: auto invokes it unchanged, confirm refuses it until a matching human approval exists, deny refuses it unconditionally.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled policy is treated as absent when resolving the effective policy (falls through to the next tier — instance default, then the fully-open fallback), mirroring Budget.enabled.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Per-organisation or per-agent spend guardrail (tokens and/or EUR per period): a soft threshold that warns without blocking, and a hard cap that blocks NEW runs for the budgeted scope at the same dispatch gate the kill-switch and human-approval gate use (never aborts a run already in progress). Current-period usage is computed on read from the existing run AuditTrail — never a stored counter.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Whether this budget applies to the whole organisation or to one agent.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the budgeted agent. Required when scope=agent; empty for scope=organisation.

period.title: Period
period.description: The recurring window current-period usage is windowed to.

tokenLimit.title: Token limit
tokenLimit.description: Hard token cap per period. At least one of tokenLimit/eurLimit is required (service-level validation).

eurLimit.title: EUR limit
eurLimit.description: Hard EUR cap per period. Only usable when the instance-wide EUR-per-1k-tokens rate is configured.

softThresholdPercent.title: Soft threshold (%)
softThresholdPercent.description: When current-period usage crosses this fraction of the limit, one warning notification fires per period.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled budget is not read by the dispatch gate (kept, not deleted, for audit continuity).

warnedPeriodKey.title: Warned period key
warnedPeriodKey.description: Derived: the period key the soft-threshold warning was last sent for; empty until the first warning in a period.

lastHardBlockAt.title: Last hard block at
lastHardBlockAt.description: Derived: when a run was last blocked by this budget's hard cap, for admin visibility.

Memory.title: Agent memory
Memory.description: An agent's long-term memory (the MEMORY.md port): durable facts stored as JSON entries with a character budget. Exceeding the budget flags needsConsolidation — a nudge to summarise, never a silent truncation.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent this memory belongs to.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Memory entries as a JSON array.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable per-entry id (agent-memory-tools), generated at append time so hermiq.forgetMemory can address one entry. Absent on entries appended before agent-memory-tools shipped.

deletedAt.title: Deleted at
deletedAt.description: Set by hermiq.forgetMemory (agent-memory-tools) when the agent retracts this entry — a soft delete only. The entry is never removed from this array; it is excluded from recallMemory results and from charBudget/needsConsolidation counting once set.

charBudget.title: Character budget
charBudget.description: Character budget for entries; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation (approximate, not a hard cap).

needsConsolidation.title: Needs consolidation
needsConsolidation.description: True when the entries exceed charBudget — a nudge to consolidate; older entries are never dropped silently.

UserProfile.title: User profile
UserProfile.description: Facts an agent keeps about a subject user (the USER.md port): durable entries with a character budget and consolidation nudge, scoped to the owning organisation.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the agent maintaining this profile.

subjectUid.title: Subject user
subjectUid.description: The user id the profile describes.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Profile entries as a JSON array.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable per-entry id (agent-memory-tools), generated at append time so hermiq.forgetMemory can address one entry. Absent on entries appended before agent-memory-tools shipped.

text.title: Text
text.description: The remembered fact about the subject user.

deletedAt.title: Deleted at
deletedAt.description: Set by hermiq.forgetMemory (agent-memory-tools) when the agent retracts this entry — a soft delete only. The entry is never removed from this array; it is excluded from recallMemory results and from charBudget/needsConsolidation counting once set.

charBudget.title: Character budget
charBudget.description: Character budget for entries; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation.

needsConsolidation.title: Needs consolidation
needsConsolidation.description: True when the entries exceed charBudget.

Session.title: Session

agentId.title: Agent

lastActivityAt.title: Last activity at

agentId.title: Agent

content.title: Content
