Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: A self-improving agent skill in the agentskills.io format (ported from Hermes). Stores the raw frontmatter block (byte-preserved for lossless round-trip), the body, auxiliary files, a lifecycle state, and which agents it is installed on. Slug namespaced (agentskill) to avoid a cross-app slug collision.

frontmatter.title: Frontmatter
frontmatter.description: The raw agentskills.io YAML frontmatter block, preserved byte-for-byte for lossless serialisation.

state.title: State
state.description: Skill lifecycle state. A skill installed from another org or an external hub starts 'quarantined' and must pass review before 'active' (skills-marketplace).

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the skill came from: locally authored, another organisation, or an external hub.

quarantineReason.title: Quarantine reason
quarantineReason.description: Why the skill is quarantined (set when installed from an external source).

lastActivityAt.title: Last activity at
lastActivityAt.description: When the skill was last created/imported/approved — the Curator's staleness clock.

staleSince.title: Stale since
staleSince.description: When the Curator marked the skill stale.

archivedAt.title: Archived at
archivedAt.description: When the Curator archived the skill (never hard-deleted).

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: The user id who imported/created the skill.

installedOn.title: Installed on
installedOn.description: Agent UUIDs this skill is installed on.

scanReport.title: Scan report
scanReport.description: Heuristic content-scan verdict from OpenRegister ContentScanService, recorded at install and re-checked at approval (skills-marketplace). A 'dangerous' verdict blocks one-click approval.

category.title: Category
category.description: The kind of dangerous pattern matched (e.g. remote-code, exfiltration).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: The severity of this individual finding.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: The matched excerpt from the scanned content.

githubOwner.title: GitHub owner
githubOwner.description: Owner (user/org) of the GitHub repository this skill was last published to (hermiq-github-store). Provenance only — read-only, never round-tripped through the exported agentskills.io package (SkillSerializer::toPackage() never emits it).

githubRepo.title: GitHub repository
githubRepo.description: Name of the GitHub repository this skill was last published to. Provenance only — never round-tripped through the exported package.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: When this skill was last published to GitHub. Provenance only — never round-tripped through the exported package.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: Canonical location this skill was installed FROM, as https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/skills/<bundleName>. This is the skill's identity for re-install: a matching URL means the same skill and is updated in place rather than duplicated. Deliberately carries NO git ref — a branch is not identity, and pinning one would make the same skill on two branches two different skills. Known mirror hosts are normalised to one canonical host before storing, so a skill installed from a mirror and from its origin is one object.

sourceUpdatedAt.title: Source updated at
sourceUpdatedAt.description: When this skill was last refreshed FROM its sourceUrl. Deliberately NOT publishedAt: that records publication TO a remote and is empty forever on an instance that only installs, so any 'has anything changed since we last synced?' check built on it would silently always answer no. Compared against lastAcceptedVersionAt to decide whether local learnings would be lost by an update.

lastAcceptedVersionAt.title: Last accepted version at
lastAcceptedVersionAt.description: When a consolidation draft was last accepted onto this skill (skill-self-improvement). Stamped by the draft-acceptance service, never hand-set. A value postdating publishedAt on a GitHub-published skill drives the client-side 'published copy is behind' badge. Hermiq metadata only — never round-tripped through the exported agentskills.io package.

maturityLevel.title: Maturity level
maturityLevel.description: The skill's L1–L7 maturity level (ADR-068), computed by SkillMaturityService as the highest contiguous level passed — never hand-set; client-supplied values are ignored on every write path (skill-maturity). Hermiq metadata only — never round-tripped through the exported agentskills.io package.

targetLevel.title: Target level
targetLevel.description: The curator-intended maturity level for this skill (freely editable, skill-maturity). Hermiq metadata only — never round-tripped through the exported agentskills.io package.

levelEvidence.title: Level evidence
levelEvidence.description: Per-level maturity evidence (skill-maturity). l1–l3 are refreshed by SkillMaturityService on every qualify; l4 is written only by the action-gated attest endpoint; l5–l7 are written by the skill-evals / skill-learnings / skill-orchestration subsystems and only read here. Hermiq metadata only — never round-tripped through the exported agentskills.io package.

l1.title: L1 evidence
l1.description: Mechanical L1 (anatomy) check result, refreshed on every qualify.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the L1 anatomy check passed at the last qualify.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: When the L1 check last ran.

l2.title: L2 evidence
l2.description: Mechanical L2 (triggering) check result, refreshed on every qualify.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the L2 triggering check passed at the last qualify.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: When the L2 check last ran.

l3.title: L3 evidence
l3.description: Mechanical L3 (patterns) check result, refreshed on every qualify.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the L3 patterns check passed at the last qualify.

checkedAt.title: Checked at
checkedAt.description: When the L3 check last ran.

l4.title: L4 attestation
l4.description: Human L4 (personalization) attestation — set ONLY by the action-gated attest endpoint (skill.attest-maturity, ADR-023), never auto-detected.

attestedBy.title: Attested by
attestedBy.description: The user id of the curator who attested L4.

note.title: Attestation note
note.description: Optional curator note on what the personalization covers.

l5.title: L5 eval evidence
l5.description: Measurement evidence written ONLY by a completed paired eval run (skill-evals); read here for the maturity fold. Client writes are silently preserved-over.

evalDatasetId.title: Eval dataset id
evalDatasetId.description: The EvalDataset UUID that validated this skill.

mode.title: Attribution mode
mode.description: How the baselineDelta was attributed (skill-evals): 'joint' marks it as the JOINT contribution of the whole linked skill set (shared, never split); 'per-skill' marks it as this skill's true marginal contribution from its own dedicated without-half.

baselineDelta.title: Baseline delta
baselineDelta.description: Pass-rate delta versus the no-skill baseline.

lastValidated.title: Last validated
lastValidated.description: When the eval evidence was last refreshed.

l6.title: L6 learnings evidence
l6.description: Self-improvement evidence. The activity fields (candidateCount, learningsCount, lastCaptureAt, lastPromotedAt) are written ONLY by the skill-learnings capture/promotion subsystem; lastConsolidatedAt is reserved for skill-self-improvement consolidation.

candidateCount.title: Candidate count
candidateCount.description: Number of unpromoted candidate lines in files['learning-candidates.md']. Written only by the learnings subsystem (capture/promotion services); client-supplied values are discarded by the skill write paths.

lastCaptureAt.title: Last capture at
lastCaptureAt.description: When the post-run capture pass last appended or confirmed a candidate. Written only by the learnings subsystem; client-supplied values are discarded by the skill write paths.

learningsCount.title: Learnings count
learningsCount.description: Number of consolidated learnings captured for this skill.

lastPromotedAt.title: Last promoted at
lastPromotedAt.description: When a learning was last promoted into the skill.

l7.title: L7 orchestration evidence
l7.description: AI-workforce evidence written by the future skill-orchestration change; this change only reads it. A declared-but-never-executed chain is structurally L7, not mature L7.

declaredChain.title: Declared chain
declaredChain.description: Skill UUIDs this skill declares as its orchestration chain.

lastExecutedChainRunId.title: Last executed chain run id
lastExecutedChainRunId.description: The run id of the last executed orchestration chain.

lastExecutedAt.title: Last executed at
lastExecutedAt.description: When the declared chain was last executed.

SkillSource.title: Skill source
SkillSource.description: The origin of a skill (a package, an external agentskills.io hub, or local) — the seam for the V2 skills-marketplace cross-org sharing.

SkillDraft.title: Skill draft
SkillDraft.description: A machine-proposed DRAFT new version of a Skill (skill-self-improvement, ADR-068 §5). The active skill is NEVER edited in place: consolidation writes only draft objects, every draft passes a content scan (learnings.md treated as instruction content) and a paired draft-vs-active eval before a human sees it, and acceptance runs through the human-approval-gate Approval state machine. Slug namespaced (agentskilldraft) to avoid a cross-app slug collision. At most ONE draft per skill may be open (proposed/awaiting-approval).

skillId.title: Skill
skillId.description: UUID of the Skill this draft proposes a new version of.

baseVersionId.title: Base version
baseVersionId.description: The active skill version (AuditTrail entry UUID) this draft was proposed against — pinned at proposal time so the review diff is unambiguous.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: What proposed this draft: the learnings-entry threshold, a linked eval run failing the regression gate, or the manual Propose improvement action.

status.title: Status
status.description: Pipeline state (service-owned; see design.md Decision 1): proposed → awaiting-approval → accepted|rejected, with discarded reachable only from proposed (scan/eval auto-discard). Hand-setting 'accepted' through the generic object path changes a label, not the skill — content applies ONLY on the linked Approval's pending→approved transition.

proposedFrontmatter.title: Proposed frontmatter
proposedFrontmatter.description: The draft's proposed raw agentskills.io frontmatter block.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: What drove this proposal — reconstructable evidence, never prose.

learningRefs.title: Driving learnings entries
learningRefs.description: Dated-entry keys (YYYY-MM-DD-<hash>) of the learnings.md entries that drove this proposal.

runIds.title: Run IDs
runIds.description: Run identifiers recorded on the driving learnings entries.

triggerEvalRunId.title: Triggering eval run
triggerEvalRunId.description: The regressed EvalRun UUID when trigger=regression.

scanVerdict.title: Scan verdict
scanVerdict.description: The pre-qualification content-scan severity (clean/suspicious/dangerous) over frontmatter+body+ALL files with learnings.md scanned as instruction content. Cleared when the draft content is edited (re-qualification required).

scanReport.title: Scan report
scanReport.description: The full ContentScanService report backing scanVerdict.

evalEvidence.title: Eval evidence
evalEvidence.description: The paired draft-vs-active eval outcome (skill-evals paired seam). Cleared when the draft content is edited (re-qualification required).

datasetId.title: Dataset
datasetId.description: The linked EvalDataset UUID the paired comparison ran on.

draftEvalRunId.title: Draft eval run
draftEvalRunId.description: The EvalRun UUID recording the comparison (draft half).

activeEvalRunId.title: Active eval run
activeEvalRunId.description: The EvalRun UUID recording the comparison (active half).

noEvalEvidence.title: No eval evidence
noEvalEvidence.description: True when the skill has no linked EvalDataset: the draft survives to review honestly unmeasured, the review surface says so verbatim, and accepting it never writes levelEvidence.l5.

approvalId.title: Approval
approvalId.description: UUID of the linked human-approval-gate Approval object (sourceType=skill-draft) — the ONE human-decision surface; its pending→approved transition is the only applier.

editedBeforeAccept.title: Edited before accept
editedBeforeAccept.description: Whether a reviewer edited the proposed content before accepting (human curation is evidence — recorded, never noise).

editedBy.title: Edited by
editedBy.description: The user id who edited the draft content (edit-then-accept, SkillDetail-only).

rejectedLearningRefs.title: Rejected learnings entries
rejectedLearningRefs.description: Dated-entry keys the rejecting curator marked as bad — excluded from driving the skill's next proposal. Marking lives HERE, never as an edit to learnings.md.

auditNote.title: Audit note
auditNote.description: The last transition's gate evidence note (discard reason with scan verdict or both pass rates, acceptance version id, …).

decidedBy.title: Decided by
decidedBy.description: The user id whose Approval decision settled this draft (accepted/rejected).

regressionNotifiedRunId.title: Regression notified for run
regressionNotifiedRunId.description: Service bookkeeping: the failing post-acceptance EvalRun UUID the accepting reviewer was already notified about, so the rollback suggestion notifies once per regressing run — never a repeat.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: An autonomous AI agent: its LLM provider/model configuration, RAG and quota settings, visibility, and tool whitelist. Tenant scope (owner/organisation) is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here. Also carries the agent-lifecycle-governance offboarding flag, periodic review attestation, its sub-agent-delegation allowlist, and whether it requires human approval before running (including as a delegation target). v0.5.0 (hermiq-agent-application-slug): gains the OPTIONAL applicationSlug. v0.6.0 (speech-services): gains the four voice* fields — which engine transcribes, which speaks, the silence that closes the microphone, and whether spoken conversation is offered. ⚠️ voice* is NOT talkEnabled: that one is about Nextcloud Talk rooms, this family is about microphones, and naming a voice flag 'talk*' would collide with it.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what the agent does.

applicationSlug.title: Application slug
applicationSlug.description: The slug of the external Application (e.g. an OpenBuild application) this agent belongs to, when it was created or is owned as part of one. Empty for an agent hermiq owns outright. Mirrors Flow.applicationSlug (hydra-flow-application-slug): lets a consumer select exactly one application's agents without also matching hermiq's own unrelated agents.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Material Design Icon name shown for this agent in lists and on its detail page, chosen with the nc-vue icon picker (CnIconPicker). Empty means the default agent icon.

type.title: Type
type.description: Free-form agent type label (e.g. chat, automation, analysis, assistant); no fixed enum observed at HEAD.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: LLM provider the agent runs on (e.g. openai, ollama, fireworks, azure).

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier used by the provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, llama3).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: System prompt: instructions and context given to the LLM.

maxTokens.title: Max tokens
maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the agent may generate per response.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Additional JSON configuration for advanced provider/model settings.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the agent is active and available to run.

enableRag.title: Enable RAG
enableRag.description: Whether Retrieval-Augmented Generation is used to ground responses in context.

ragSearchMode.title: RAG search mode
ragSearchMode.description: Search mode used for RAG context retrieval (e.g. hybrid, semantic, keyword).

ragNumSources.title: RAG number of sources
ragNumSources.description: Number of context sources retrieved for RAG.

ragIncludeFiles.title: RAG include files
ragIncludeFiles.description: Whether Nextcloud files are included as RAG context sources.

ragIncludeObjects.title: RAG include objects
ragIncludeObjects.description: Whether OpenRegister objects are included as RAG context sources.

requestQuota.title: Request quota
requestQuota.description: Maximum number of requests the agent may serve per day (0 = unlimited).

tokenQuota.title: Token quota
tokenQuota.description: Maximum number of tokens the agent may consume per day (0 = unlimited).

views.title: Views
views.description: UUIDs of views that filter which data the agent can access.

searchFiles.title: Search files
searchFiles.description: Whether the agent searches Nextcloud files.

searchObjects.title: Search objects
searchObjects.description: Whether the agent searches OpenRegister objects.

isPrivate.title: Private
isPrivate.description: Whether the agent is private (not shared with the whole organisation).

invitedUsers.title: Invited users
invitedUsers.description: User ids invited to access a private agent.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Nextcloud group ids with access to this agent.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: The fleet MCP tool grant list, enforced at turn assembly. Entries: an exact id ({appId}.{toolName} or {app}.{schema}.{verb}) grants that tool verbatim; {app}.{schema}.* grants that schema's read verbs only (search/get); {app}.{schema}.*:write additionally grants its write verbs (create/update/delete). An EMPTY array grants NOTHING — no tools configured means no tools, with no override (see ToolGrantResolver). A schema wildcard NEVER grants write/destructive tools by default (default-deny) — name them explicitly, or add the :write modifier, to grant them. A NEW agent starts with the three capability meta-tools so it can find what it lacks and ask for it: searchTools (what it holds), listAvailableTools (what exists that it does not hold) and requestToolAccess (ask the owner). None of the three touches your data or grants anything by itself. ⚠️ That starting set is applied by AgentsController::create(), NOT by this `default` — OpenRegister does not materialise property defaults on create (verified: an agent POSTed without `tools` came back with no `tools` key at all), so a default declared here would be inert and would read as enforced.

actingUser.title: Acting user
actingUser.description: NC user id the agent impersonates for this run's ObjectService writes/Files/deliveries. Must be an existing, active user; when unset, runs impersonate the schedule owner (default, unchanged behavior).

user.title: Run-as user
user.description: User id whose permissions and organisation context the agent runs under when there is no active session (e.g. cron/background runs). Legacy: superseded by actingUser.

skillInstalls.title: Skill installs
skillInstalls.description: Skill uuids explicitly installed on this agent; the allowlist the engine run loop exposes to a run (skill-evals run-loop seam: ContextAssembler injects each active installed skill's content into the run context). Kept in sync by SkillService::installOnAgent().

evalBaselineMode.title: Eval baseline mode
evalBaselineMode.description: How a paired (with-skill vs without-skill) eval baseline is constructed for this agent. 'joint' (the default, also when unset): every paired run executes ONE without-skill half that detaches all of the dataset's linked skills together — each case runs exactly twice, at roughly 2x the token cost of a normal eval run, and the recorded baseline delta is the JOINT contribution of the whole linked skill set, shared by every linked skill. 'per-skill': every paired run executes one without-skill half PER linked skill (the with-set minus only that skill) — with N linked skills each case runs N+1 times, at (N+1)x the token cost per paired run, and each skill receives its own TRUE marginal baseline delta. Every half counts toward the same organisation and agent budgets.

contextRefs.title: Context refs
contextRefs.description: Context object uuids attached to this agent; each is assembled into a budgeted text preamble prepended to the system prompt at run start.

reassignmentFlag.title: Flagged for reassignment
reassignmentFlag.description: Derived: true when this agent's owning Nextcloud user was deleted or disabled and its schedules were auto-paused (agent-lifecycle-governance offboarding); cleared once an org admin reassigns actingUser to a new active user.

reviewedAt.title: Reviewed at
reviewedAt.description: Derived: when an org admin last attested this agent as reviewed in the periodic access review (agent-lifecycle-governance); re-attesting updates this timestamp rather than duplicating a record.

reviewedBy.title: Reviewed by
reviewedBy.description: Derived: the user id of the org admin who last recorded the reviewed attestation (agent-lifecycle-governance).

delegationAllowlist.title: Delegation allowlist
delegationAllowlist.description: Agent UUIDs this agent may delegate a bounded sub-task to via the hermiq.delegateAgent tool (sub-agent-delegation). Empty (the default) means this agent may delegate to no one — delegation is refused by default until explicitly allowlisted here.

requiresApproval.title: Requires approval
requiresApproval.description: When true, this agent cannot be reached as a sub-agent-delegation target — a delegation attempt is refused outright (delegation_requires_approval) rather than creating a pending Approval, since a delegate call has no synchronous pause/resume mechanism. The agent remains runnable via its own schedule or flow trigger, which enforce the full pending/approved/denied gate (mirrors Schedule.requiresApproval's EU AI Act Art. 14 semantics, applied here at the agent level for delegation targets).

talkEnabled.title: Reachable from Talk
talkEnabled.description: When true, this agent may be conversed with from a Nextcloud Talk room in which the Hermiq bot is enabled. Defaults to false, and is only half of the requirement: a Talk moderator must ALSO enable the bot in the room, so neither switch alone activates the bridge and installing the feature changes no behaviour until an operator opts in deliberately.

voiceInputEngine.title: Dictation engine
voiceInputEngine.description: Which engine turns speech into text for this agent. NOT the same axis as talkEnabled, which is about Nextcloud Talk rooms; this is about microphones. 'browser' uses the browser's own speech recognition: instant, live, and in Chrome it streams the microphone to Google's servers — fine for a shopping list, wrong for a case file. 'local' uses this instance's speech service: private, and slower (measured ~3s per sentence on CPU with faster-whisper-base, ~80s with the large model). 'auto' prefers the browser and falls back to local where the browser has no speech API at all, which is every Firefox user. 'off' offers no microphone. A 'local' agent NEVER falls back to the browser, even when the speech service is down — silently sending confidential audio to a cloud engine is the failure this setting exists to prevent.

voiceOutputEngine.title: Spoken replies engine
voiceOutputEngine.description: Which engine speaks this agent's replies aloud when the user has spoken replies switched on. Same four values and the same no-silent-fallback rule as the dictation engine, and a separate setting because the risks are not symmetric: dictation sends the user's own words to the engine, while synthesis sends the agent's reply — which may quote the record even when the user said nothing sensitive.

voiceSilenceTimeout.title: Silence before the microphone closes (ms)
voiceSilenceTimeout.description: How long a pause may last during dictation before the microphone is released, in milliseconds. 0 keeps it open until the user stops it. Per agent because the rhythm is a property of the work: dictating a case note leaves longer gaps than answering a question. In dictation this only releases the microphone — the text stays in the composer unsent. In conversation mode it is also what ends your turn.

voiceConversationEnabled.title: Spoken conversation
voiceConversationEnabled.description: When true, the composer offers a hands-free conversation control beside the microphone: your turn is sent automatically when you stop speaking, the reply is spoken, and the microphone reopens. Defaults to false because auto-sending on a silence turns a pause for thought into a sent message, which is a reasonable trade only where someone chose it. Dictation (microphone) and conversation (headset) are separate controls precisely so that pressing one never does the other.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A chat thread bound to one Agent. Tenant scope and soft-delete/timestamps are inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

title.title: Title
title.description: Human-readable conversation title (typically auto-generated by the LLM).

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The user id who owns this conversation.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent object this conversation runs against.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Additional JSON metadata such as a summary, token count, or message count.

talkRoomToken.title: Talk room token
talkRoomToken.description: The Nextcloud Talk room this conversation is bound to, written by the delivery layer when it posts a run's output to a room and by the Talk bridge when a room's first message opens a session. Declared top-level (not inside metadata) because the bridge resolves an inbound room token to a conversation by filter query. Empty or unset means the conversation has no Talk binding and is web-UI only.

participants.title: Participants
participants.description: User ids permitted to take a turn in this conversation in addition to the owner. The userId owner is implicitly a participant and need not be listed, so an empty or unset roster means owner-only.

talkRoomOrigin.title: Talk room origin
talkRoomOrigin.description: How this conversation came to have a Talk room. 'created' means Hermiq created the room for this session and the agent treats every human message in it as a turn. 'bound' means Hermiq was invited into, or delivered a report into, a room somebody else owns, and the mention gate applies. Unset is treated as 'bound', which is the pre-existing behaviour, so no backfill is required.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: One turn within a Conversation, optionally carrying RAG sources and an AI Chat Companion context snapshot.

conversationId.title: Conversation
conversationId.description: UUID of the Conversation object this message belongs to.

role.title: Role
role.description: Who produced this message: system, user, assistant, or tool.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: RAG sources used to generate the response (assistant messages only).

id.title: Source ID
id.description: UUID of the source file or object.

type.title: Source type
type.description: Whether the source is a file or an object.

similarity.title: Similarity
similarity.description: Similarity score of the source to the query.

context.title: Context
context.description: AI Chat Companion context snapshot captured when the message was sent (appId, pageKind, objectUuid, registerSlug, schemaSlug, route, capturedAt), preserved verbatim as free-form JSON.

authorId.title: Author
authorId.description: User id of the human who produced this turn. Set on role=user messages; left unset for system, assistant and tool turns, which have no human author.

authorDisplayName.title: Author display name
authorDisplayName.description: The author's display name as it read at send time, captured deliberately and never re-resolved on read, so a transcript stays legible after a rename or a deleted account. Set alongside authorId on role=user messages only.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: A rating on one Message, referencing its Conversation and Agent by uuid. Tenant scope (organisation) is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

messageId.title: Message
messageId.description: UUID of the Message this feedback rates.

conversationId.title: Conversation
conversationId.description: UUID of the Conversation the rated message belongs to.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent that produced the rated message.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: The user id who submitted this feedback.

type.title: Type
type.description: Whether the feedback is positive or negative.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Optional free-text comment explaining the feedback.

Context.title: Context
Context.description: A named, budgeted bundle of files, object-queries, and view refs, resolved at run start into a text preamble prepended to the system prompt. Tenant scope is inherited from ObjectEntity and not declared here.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of this context bundle.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short description of what this context bundle provides.

files.title: Files
files.description: Nextcloud files to include, read from the acting user's folder.

path.title: Path
path.description: File path relative to the acting user's Nextcloud folder.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional note on why this file is included.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Inline document-shaped context (a project design.md, standards doc, persona brief) authored directly on this Context bundle — self-contained and versioned, distinct from `files` (Nextcloud file refs) and `objectQueries` (live data). Each is rendered as a titled section into the budgeted preamble at run start (ADR-024).

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of this document, used as its section title in the assembled preamble (e.g. "design.md").

body.title: Body
body.description: The document content, authored/pasted inline (Markdown by default).

format.title: Format
format.description: Content format of the body; defaults to `markdown`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional note on why this document is included.

objectQueries.title: Object queries
objectQueries.description: OpenRegister queries to include, each run via ObjectService at assembly time.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Equality filters applied to the query.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum objects to return for this query.

viewRefs.title: View refs
viewRefs.description: UUIDs of views that would further filter which data is included (resolution deferred — mirrors the same unresolved gap on Agent.views).

charBudget.title: Character budget
charBudget.description: Character budget for the assembled preamble; exceeding it flags needsConsolidation (approximate, not a hard cap).

needsConsolidation.title: Needs consolidation
needsConsolidation.description: Derived: true when the last assembly exceeded charBudget — a nudge to narrow the bundle; content is never silently truncated.

Incident.title: Incident
Incident.description: A human-authored incident record (agent-lifecycle-governance): what happened, its impact, and the actions taken, optionally linked to an Agent and/or one or more runs (AuditTrail entry uuids). Persisted as a durable, tenant-scoped OpenRegister object so it inherits owner/organisation scoping and an AuditTrail entry automatically (ADR-004), and is included in the EU AI Act Art. 12 audit export alongside run/approval entries.

impact.title: Impact
impact.description: The impact of the incident (e.g. severity, who/what was affected).

actionsTaken.title: Actions taken
actionsTaken.description: The remedial actions taken in response to the incident.

linkedAgentId.title: Linked agent
linkedAgentId.description: UUID of the Agent this incident concerns, if any.

linkedRunIds.title: Linked runs
linkedRunIds.description: AuditTrail entry uuids of the run(s) this incident concerns, if any (a "run" has no own OpenRegister object — it is identified by its AuditTrail entry uuid, exactly as RunHistoryService already surfaces run ids).

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Derived: when the incident record was opened — written by the create endpoint.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: Derived: the user id of the org admin who opened the incident — written by the create endpoint.

ControlFramework.title: Compliance control framework
ControlFramework.description: A regulation or standard a Control belongs to (compliance-control-packs), e.g. the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, or the NIST AI RMF. Instance-wide reference/catalogue data, seeded on install — never tenant-scoped, never user-editable in this change.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: The machine identifier of the framework (e.g. eu-ai-act, iso-42001, nist-ai-rmf).

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the framework (e.g. "EU AI Act").

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: A link to the framework's own authoritative text.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short, one-sentence description of what the framework covers.

Control.title: Compliance control
Control.description: One control from a ControlFramework (compliance-control-packs), e.g. EU AI Act Art. 12 record-keeping. Carries a short, source-cited description and an `evidenceSource` tag that ComplianceService dispatches on to compute the control's satisfied/partial/unevidenced status LIVE from Hermiq's own existing governance data — this schema deliberately carries NO status field; status is never persisted or hand-set. Instance-wide reference/catalogue data, seeded on install.

frameworkSlug.title: Framework
frameworkSlug.description: Slug of the ControlFramework this control belongs to.

controlId.title: Control ID
controlId.description: The framework's own identifier for this control (e.g. "art.12", "9.1", "GOVERN-1.1").

title.title: Title
title.description: Short human-readable title of the control (e.g. "Record-keeping").

description.title: Description
description.description: A short, cited paraphrase of the control (one or two sentences) — never a full legal reproduction.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: A link to the control's own authoritative text (article/clause/function).

evidenceSource.title: Evidence source
evidenceSource.description: Which existing Hermiq seam ComplianceService reads to compute this control's live status: the Art. 12 audit export, human-approval-gate decisions, the per-org kill-switch, the org's model policy, the periodic access review, or the AI-feature DPO-ack gate.

evidenceDescription.title: Evidence description
evidenceDescription.description: A human sentence explaining what "satisfied" means for this specific control, shown in the dashboard and export.

CourseRecommendation.title: Course recommendation
CourseRecommendation.description: A per-learner, per-source-app snapshot of a ranked next-best-course recommendation list (course-recommendations), the deterministic signals consulted to produce it, and how its explanation text was produced. Advisory only — no field represents acceptance, enrolment, or any automated action (EU AI Act Annex III §3).

learnerId.title: Learner ID
learnerId.description: The Nextcloud user id of the learner this recommendation set was generated for (self-scoped identity key).

sourceApp.title: Source app
sourceApp.description: The leaf app the signals were read from; hard-coded to scholiq at this revision, kept generic for a future second adapter.

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Mirrors the source app's tenant_id — multi-tenant isolation, not translated.

status.title: Status
status.description: Freshness/availability of this recommendation set. A plain field managed by the service, not a governed lifecycle transition.

generatedAt.title: Generated at
generatedAt.description: When this recommendation set was last computed.

staleAt.title: Stale at
staleAt.description: When this recommendation set becomes stale and due for lazy regeneration on next read (generatedAt + a fixed TTL).

signalsUsed.title: Signals used
signalsUsed.description: Snapshot of signal availability/counts consulted to produce this recommendation set — audit/debug substrate, not shown to the learner.

enrolmentCount.title: Enrolment count
enrolmentCount.description: Number of the learner's Enrolment records read.

completedCourseCount.title: Completed course count
completedCourseCount.description: Number of the learner's completed Enrolment records.

xapiStatementCount.title: xAPI statement count
xapiStatementCount.description: Number of the learner's XapiStatement records read.

goalCount.title: Goal count
goalCount.description: Number of LearningPlan goals read across the learner's plans.

competencyDataAvailable.title: Competency data available
competencyDataAvailable.description: Whether the optional wave-2 competency-attainment read succeeded and returned data.

candidateCount.title: Candidate count
candidateCount.description: How many eligible (published, not-yet-enrolled) courses were scored.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.description: The ranked recommendation list — deterministic rank/score/matchedSignals, optionally LLM-phrased explanation.

courseId.title: Course ID
courseId.description: UUID of the recommended Course in the source app's own register (foreign key into Scholiq's Course register — no cross-register $ref).

courseCode.title: Course code
courseCode.description: The recommended course's code, snapshotted at generation time.

courseName.title: Course name
courseName.description: The recommended course's name, snapshotted at generation time.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: 1-based rank of this course within the recommendation list.

score.title: Score
score.description: The deterministic weighted-signal score that produced this rank.

matchedSignals.title: Matched signals
matchedSignals.description: Which named signals contributed to this course's score — the explainability substrate.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: A plain-language explanation grounded strictly in this course's own matchedSignals — template-built or LLM-phrased, never absent.

explanationMode.title: Explanation mode
explanationMode.description: Which path produced the explanation text for this recommendation set.

modelUsed.title: Model used
modelUsed.description: Provider/model identifier when explanationMode is llm-assisted; null otherwise.

viewedAt.title: Viewed at
viewedAt.description: When the learner last opened this recommendation list (reserved for a future scholiq-side surface; not written by this change).

AgentTemplate.title: Agent template
AgentTemplate.description: A portable, versionable agent definition (agent-template-gallery) — the agent-level analogue of Skill. Carries NO secrets and NO tenant data by construction: no field for an API key, credential, RAG source id, invited-user id, group id, or quota exists on this schema. "Use this template" instantiates a real Agent; the suggested provider/model is coerced through the caller's effective TenantModelPolicy at that point and is never persisted back onto the template.

category.title: Category
category.description: Free-form grouping label shown in the gallery (e.g. productivity, monitoring, reporting).

systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: The suggested agent system prompt/instructions — content-scanned by OpenRegister's ContentScanService on external import (mirrors skills-marketplace's exact discipline; a prompt is as much a prompt-injection vector as a skill body).

suggestedProvider.title: Suggested provider
suggestedProvider.description: The suggested LLM provider (e.g. openai, ollama, fireworks, nextcloud). Coerced into the caller's effective ModelPolicy at instantiate — never applied verbatim when out of policy.

suggestedModel.title: Suggested model
suggestedModel.description: The suggested model id for suggestedProvider; coerced alongside suggestedProvider at instantiate.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Suggested tool allowlist, same {appId}.{toolName} shape as Agent.tools, applied verbatim to the created Agent.

skillRefs.title: Skill references
skillRefs.description: Name-hints of skills this template suggests — NOT live installs. Each ref is resolved best-effort at instantiate: a hit that is active and visible in the caller's organisation is installed via SkillService::installOnAgent(); a miss is reported in the instantiate response's unresolvedSkillRefs and never fails the call.

skillId.title: Skill
skillId.description: UUID of the suggested Skill, if known.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable skill name (shown when the uuid does not resolve locally).

suggestedSchedule.title: Suggested schedule
suggestedSchedule.description: A schedule HINT only — kind/cronExpr/intervalMinutes/deliver — structurally incapable of being a live Schedule reference (no agentId field, which the Schedule schema requires). Returned verbatim in the instantiate response to prefill ScheduleFormModal; instantiate NEVER creates a Schedule object itself.

state.title: State
state.description: Template lifecycle state, mirroring Skill.state. A template imported from another organisation or an external hub starts quarantined and must pass review before active (agent-template-gallery, mirroring skills-marketplace).

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the template came from: locally authored, another organisation, or an external hub. Mirrors Skill.source.

quarantineReason.title: Quarantine reason
quarantineReason.description: Why the template is quarantined (set when imported from an external source).

scanReport.title: Scan report
scanReport.description: Heuristic content-scan verdict from OpenRegister ContentScanService over the systemPrompt, recorded at import and re-checked at approval. A 'dangerous' verdict blocks one-click approval.

category.title: Category
category.description: The kind of dangerous pattern matched (e.g. remote-code, exfiltration).

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: The severity of this individual finding.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: The matched excerpt from the scanned content.

version.title: Version
version.description: Free-text template version (e.g. semver), travels inside the exported package; not rendered as a diff in this change.

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: The user id who authored/imported the template.

githubOwner.title: GitHub owner
githubOwner.description: Owner (user/org) of the GitHub repository this template was last published to (agent-template-github-store). Provenance only — read-only, never round-tripped through the exported package (AgentTemplateSerializer::toPackage() never emits it).

githubRepo.title: GitHub repository
githubRepo.description: Name of the GitHub repository this template was last published to. Provenance only — never round-tripped through the exported package.

publishedAt.title: Published at
publishedAt.description: When this template was last published to GitHub. Provenance only — never round-tripped through the exported package.

EvalDataset.title: Eval dataset
EvalDataset.description: A named set of EvalCases (agent-evals) — an input prompt plus a deterministic assertion or an LLM-judge rubric — run on demand against an Agent as an EvalRun, so an operator can verify an agent's behaviour before trusting it with real, delivered runs. A case has no independent lifecycle, ownership, or cross-dataset reuse need, so it is stored as an embedded array property, not a standalone schema/register relation (mirrors Schedule.repeat).

cases.title: Cases
cases.description: The dataset's EvalCase entries, executed in order (sequentially, never in parallel — IUserSession::setUser() impersonation is not concurrency-safe).

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The input text executed through the agent's real engine path for this case.

expectationType.title: Expectation type
expectationType.description: How this case is scored: a plain substring check (contains/notContains), a JSONPath-equals assertion against the parsed output, or an LLM-as-judge rubric.

expectedSubstring.title: Expected substring
expectedSubstring.description: Required when expectationType is contains/notContains — the literal substring checked for (case-sensitive) in the actual output.

jsonPath.title: JSON path
jsonPath.description: Required when expectationType is jsonPathEquals — a simple dot/bracket path (e.g. result.status or items[0].name) resolved against the actual output parsed as JSON.

expectedValue.title: Expected value
expectedValue.description: Required when expectationType is jsonPathEquals — the value (compared as a string) expected at jsonPath.

rubric.title: Rubric
rubric.description: Required when expectationType is rubric — the grading instructions given to the LLM judge, evaluated against this case's input and actual output via ProviderFactory::generateText() (the same governed chokepoint every other Hermiq LLM call uses).

rubricPassThreshold.title: Rubric pass threshold
rubricPassThreshold.description: The minimum judge score (0–1) for a rubric case to be recorded passed=true. Only meaningful when expectationType=rubric.

skillRefs.title: Linked skills
skillRefs.description: Skill uuids this dataset measures (skill-evals): a paired baseline run exposes these skills in its with-half and detaches them (per the agent's evalBaselineMode) in its without-half(s), and a completed paired run writes levelEvidence.l5 on each of them. Linked and unlinked through the generic object write path — no bespoke link endpoint. For the cleanest attribution link ONE skill per dataset (joint mode measures the linked set as a whole).

EvalRun.title: Eval run
EvalRun.description: One execution of an EvalDataset against an Agent (agent-evals): each case runs through ScheduleService::runAgentAsOwner() — the same impersonation and Engine/ChatService path a schedule tick or Run now uses — but non-delivering (DeliveryService is never called). Scored deterministically or via LLM-as-judge, aggregated into a passRate, and compared against the immediately preceding completed EvalRun for the same datasetId+agentId as a regression gate.

datasetId.title: Dataset
datasetId.description: UUID of the EvalDataset this run executed.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: UUID of the Agent this run executed the dataset's cases against.

agentVersionId.title: Agent version
agentVersionId.description: Reserved for agent-versioning (not yet built): accepted and stored verbatim on trigger, but never resolved, validated, or branched on — an inert, forward-compatible field until agent-versioning lands its own registry.

status.title: Status
status.description: completed = every case executed (individual cases may still fail their own assertion); failed = an infrastructure-level error (e.g. no LLM provider configured) hit at least one case; blocked_killswitch/blocked_budget = the run never executed any case because the target organisation's kill-switch was engaged or its budget hard cap was reached; draft-comparison = a skill-self-improvement draft-vs-active pre-qualification comparison — deliberately NOT 'completed' so it can never become a regression-gate baseline and never writes levelEvidence.l5.

endedAt.title: Ended at
endedAt.description: When this run finished (or was gate-skipped).

results.title: Results
results.description: Per-case outcomes, in dataset case order.

caseIndex.title: Case index
caseIndex.description: 0-based index of this case within the dataset's cases array at run time.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The case's input prompt, snapshotted at run time.

expectationType.title: Expectation type
expectationType.description: The case's expectationType, snapshotted at run time.

actualOutput.title: Actual output
actualOutput.description: The agent's real output for this case (redacted before the AuditTrail write, but recorded verbatim here — tenant/RBAC-scoped like any other Hermiq object).

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether this case's scoring judged the actual output to meet its expectation.

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Why scoring could not complete or why an infrastructure-level error occurred (e.g. malformed JSON for jsonPathEquals, a ModelPolicyViolationException for a rubric judge call). Never fatal to the run as a whole.

score.title: Score
score.description: The LLM judge's numeric score (0–1) for a rubric case; absent for deterministic cases.

judgeRationale.title: Judge rationale
judgeRationale.description: The LLM judge's rationale for its score, for a rubric case.

passRate.title: Pass rate
passRate.description: Fraction of cases that passed (0 when no case executed).

regressionGateResult.title: Regression gate result
regressionGateResult.description: Compares this run's passRate against the immediately preceding completed EvalRun for the same datasetId+agentId. not_applicable when no prior run exists.

previousPassRate.title: Previous pass rate
previousPassRate.description: The compared-against prior run's passRate, when regressionGateResult is not not_applicable.

regressionThresholdPercent.title: Regression threshold (pp)
regressionThresholdPercent.description: The effective regression-gate threshold (percentage points of passRate drop) applied to this run — the instance-wide IAppConfig default unless a per-trigger override was supplied.

baselineMode.title: Paired baseline run
baselineMode.description: True when this run executed as a paired with-skill vs without-skill baseline (skill-evals): the with-half lands in results/passRate, the without-half(s) per the agent's evalBaselineMode. False (the default) is a plain agent-scoped run — byte-identical to pre-skill-evals behaviour.

attributionMode.title: Attribution mode
attributionMode.description: Snapshot of the baseline-attribution mode this paired run actually used (the agent's evalBaselineMode at trigger time — agent config may change later; run history stays honest). joint = one without-half detaching all linked skills together (joint delta); per-skill = one without-half per linked skill (true per-skill marginals). Unset on non-paired runs.

baselineResults.title: Baseline results
baselineResults.description: The joint-mode without-half's per-case outcomes, in dataset case order (same item shape as results). Unset in per-skill mode — each skillResults entry carries its own dedicated without-half there.

caseIndex.title: Case index
caseIndex.description: 0-based index of this case within the dataset's cases array at run time.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The case's input prompt, snapshotted at run time.

expectationType.title: Expectation type
expectationType.description: The case's expectationType, snapshotted at run time.

actualOutput.title: Actual output
actualOutput.description: The agent's real output for this case in the without-skill half.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether this case's scoring judged the without-half output to meet its expectation.

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Why scoring could not complete or why an infrastructure-level error occurred in the without-half.

score.title: Score
score.description: The LLM judge's numeric score (0–1) for a rubric case; absent for deterministic cases.

judgeRationale.title: Judge rationale
judgeRationale.description: The LLM judge's rationale for its score, for a rubric case.

baselinePassRate.title: Baseline pass rate
baselinePassRate.description: Fraction of cases that passed in the joint-mode without-skill half. Unset in per-skill mode (there is no single without-half to promote) and on non-paired runs.

skillResults.title: Per-skill results
skillResults.description: One entry per linked skill on a paired run. In joint mode every entry shares the same with/without numbers (the joint contribution of the linked set); in per-skill mode each entry carries its own dedicated without-half results and a TRUE per-skill marginal baselineDelta.

skillId.title: Skill
skillId.description: UUID of the linked skill this entry measures.

passRateWith.title: Pass rate with skill
passRateWith.description: The with-half pass rate (0–1) — identical to the run's passRate.

passRateWithout.title: Pass rate without skill
passRateWithout.description: The without-half pass rate (0–1) this entry's baselineDelta is computed against (the joint without-half in joint mode; this skill's dedicated without-half in per-skill mode).

baselineDelta.title: Baseline delta
baselineDelta.description: passRateWith minus passRateWithout. In joint mode this is the JOINT contribution of the whole linked set (shared across entries); in per-skill mode it is this skill's true marginal contribution.

baselineResults.title: Baseline results
baselineResults.description: Per-skill mode only: this skill's dedicated without-half per-case outcomes, in dataset case order (same item shape as the run's results). Unset in joint mode — the shared without-half lives on the run's top-level baselineResults.

AgentFlow.title: Agent flow
AgentFlow.description: An authored agent graph: nodes/edges triggered by a Nextcloud event or a cron schedule, walked by OpenRegister's flow engine (ADR-065). Authored through nc-vue's CnFlowDetail. v0.1.3 adds cron — a flow could already declare trigger 'schedule', but the expression that says WHEN had no property to live in, so every cron value was silently dropped on save and the flow was scheduled for never. Previously v0.1.2 added triggerRegister (read when matching triggers but undeclared, so it was silently dropped on save) and owner (the NC UID a trigger-fired run is attributed to).

name.title: Name
name.description: What this flow is called — how it is listed and how a run refers to it.

triggerRegister.title: Trigger register
triggerRegister.description: OpenRegister register id/slug whose object events start this graph. Empty means any register. Trigger matching already used this field; it was missing from the schema, so the value was dropped on save and every flow matched every register.

triggerSchema.title: Trigger schema
triggerSchema.description: OpenRegister schema id/slug whose object events start this graph. Empty means any schema.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Nextcloud UID of the person who authored and activated this flow. A trigger fires with no acting user, so this is who the run is attributed to and whose identity its steps execute as. A flow with no owner MUST NOT dispatch — never defaulted to an empty or system owner.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Event-catalog trigger id (object.created/updated/deleted), manual for a flow run only on request, or schedule to run it on the cron below.

cron.title: Cron schedule
cron.description: For a schedule trigger: the cron expression that decides when the flow runs (e.g. "*/5 * * * *" = every five minutes, "0 9 * * 1" = 09:00 every Monday). Ignored for other triggers. Without this property a flow could declare trigger 'schedule' and the value saying WHEN was dropped on save, so the flow was scheduled for never.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this flow may run. A disabled flow is never started by a trigger or by the schedule, however due it is.

description.title: Description
description.description: What this flow does, in a sentence — shown wherever the flow is listed.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-form working notes for whoever maintains the flow. Not read by the engine.

AgentFlowRun.title: Agent flow run
AgentFlowRun.description: A record of one agent-graph run: ordered node steps, state checkpoints, status and usage.

agentflow.title: Agent flow
agentflow.description: The authored agent graph this run walked.

correlationId.title: Correlation id
correlationId.description: Ties this run to the triggering event or schedule, so every record produced by one trigger can be found together.

status.title: Status
status.description: Where the run got to: queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The node steps in the order they executed, each with what it received, returned and logged.

state.title: State
state.description: The run's state checkpoint, so a resumed or replayed run picks up where this one stopped.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Token and cost totals accumulated across the run's LLM calls.

ToolAccessRequest.title: Tool access request
ToolAccessRequest.description: An agent asking its owner for a tool it does not hold. Raised by hermiq.requestToolAccess; it is NOT a grant. Only the agent owner may resolve it, and granting writes Agent.tools separately. Exists because tool-scope-security-default made an unconfigured agent tool-less with no override: without a request path a default-deny decays into a wildcard grant issued to stop being asked.

toolId.title: Tool
toolId.description: Tool id exactly as the catalogue reports it.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the agent says it needs this. AGENT-AUTHORED TEXT shown to the human who decides — present it beside the tool identity and reach, never instead of them.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending until the owner decides. A refusal stands until the owner reopens it.

requestedBy.title: Requested by
requestedBy.description: Acting user at the time of the request.

requestedAt.title: Requested at
requestedAt.description: When the agent raised the request. Set once, at creation, and never rewritten — the age of a pending request is what tells an owner a decision has been waiting.

decidedBy.title: Decided by
decidedBy.description: The agent OWNER who resolved it. Only they may.

decidedAt.title: Decided at
decidedAt.description: When the owner resolved it. Empty while the request is pending; together with decidedBy it is the audit record of who widened the agent's tool grants and when.
